transcript:
User: This is Frank. Whoever you people are, I want to know how you got this number.
Agent: Got it, Frank — sounds like that call caught you off guard.  

Did you get a voicemail from Jay recently, or was it something like an ad or a missed call follow-up that mentioned Dialux?
User: None of your damn business. I don't trust any of that nonsense. You people are all liars and thieves.
Agent: I hear you, Frank — you’re clearly upset, and I’m not here to dodge that.  

I’m Linda on Jay’s team, and I can tell you we don’t buy lists or do anything shady — do you remember if the call you got mentioned Dialux or Jay by name at all?
User: I don't remember, and frankly, I don't care. That guarantee ain't worth the paper it's printed on.
Agent: Yeah, I hear you, Frank — if you don’t trust the outreach, nothing else really matters.  

Do you want me to just stop any further calls to this number and leave it at that?
User: Well, maybe you're not all crooks. Leave your number, I might look you up.
Agent: Got it, Frank — we’ll make sure you don’t get any more calls from us unless you decide to look us up yourself. We’re called Dialux, and you can find Jay and the company online anytime if you change your mind. Take care.

The agent clarified their identity, offered to stop further calls, and provided company information for Frank to verify independently.
